version.description: App version string (e.g. "1.2.0"). Shown in Settings > System > Update app.

favicon.description: Favicon path (e.g. '/favicon.svg'). Used for the document link rel="icon".

appIcon.description: Small square app icon (e.g. '/app-icon.svg'). Shown in the sidebar header, app-bar, and windows start menu. Use a string for SVG/mono icons (auto light/dark via CSS), or `{ light, dark }` for paired PNGs.

logo.description: Logo path (e.g. '/logo.svg'). Wider wordmark; use a string or `{ light, dark }` pair. Prefer `appIcon` for the small square mark in chrome.

layout.description: Layout mode: 'sidebar' (default) or 'fullscreen'. Fullscreen shows only content with no navigation.

start_url.description: When set, opening the app at "/" redirects to this path (e.g. "/playground").

administration.description: Custom navigation for the staff admin panel (below Dashboard). Propagated to the admin iframe via SDK settings. See Administration docs.

storage.description: Storage-service connection. Propagated to iframes via SDK settings. Enables Admin → Storage when `url` is set. Settings → Storage (quota) is shown when `url` is set unless `storage.showInSettings` is false.

theme.description: Single theme: built-in name, path to a theme JSON/folder, or inline theme object. When set without `themes`, only this theme is available in the selector.

themes.description:
Available themes for the app.
- Array of built-in names, paths, or inline objects
- Map of id → name | path | object After CLI load, resolved to a `ThemeDefinition[]` for the runtime.

themesDir.description: Directory of theme JSON files (one `.json` per theme) with optional sibling `<name>/fonts/` folders. Resolved by the CLI at load/build time.

activeTheme.description: Active theme name on first visit (and when no user preference is stored). Prefer this over `defaultTheme`.

defaultTheme.description: Default theme name. Alias of `activeTheme` (kept for backward compatibility).

sentry.description: Sentry error reporting. Load from env (e.g. SENTRY_DSN). Only active in production builds.

backend.description: Backend communication config. Defaults to undefined (no backend integration).

cookieConsent.description: Cookie consent: list of cookies by category; accepted ids are stored in settings.

legalDocuments.description: Legal documents content rendered as markdown.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor autocomplete and validation.

ThemeAsset.description: Brand asset path, or separate light/dark files when CSS theming is not enough (typical for full-color PNGs). A single SVG/PNG is recolored for light/dark via CSS.

LayoutType.description: Layout mode: 'sidebar' (default) shows navigation sidebar; 'fullscreen' shows only content area; 'windows' shows a taskbar with start menu and multi-window desktop; 'app-bar' shows a compact top bar with a 9-square launcher for start links and icon-only end links.

hidden.description: When true, hide this item from the sidebar and 404 page; route remains valid and item still appears in Develop settings.

hideWhenLoggedOut.description: When true, hide this item from navigation when the user is not authenticated.

requiresAuth.description: When true, navigating to this route requires authentication and redirects to login with a next URL.

requiresDevMode.description: When true, this item is available only when Settings > Advanced > Developer features is enabled.

requiresStaff.description: When true, this item is available only to staff users (`isStaff`).

hiddenOnMobile.description: When true, hide this item on mobile (sidebar sheet). Has no effect if hidden is true.

hiddenOnDesktop.description: When true, hide this item on desktop (sidebar). Has no effect if hidden is true.

openIn.description: How to open this link: 'default' (navigate in main area), 'modal', 'drawer', or 'external' (target="_blank").

useHashRouter.description: When true, the app uses hash-based routing (e.g. /#/path). If omitted, inferred from url containing /#/.

drawerPosition.description: Optional drawer position when openIn === 'drawer'. Default is 'right' if omitted.

position.description: Sidebar position: 'start' (default) or 'end'. End items are rendered in the sidebar footer.

settings.description: URL to display as a settings panel in Settings > Applications. When set, the nav item appears in the Applications group.

safeForAuthToken.description:
Trust control for auth token sharing to iframe apps.
- undefined/true: trusted (default), token can be shared
- false: untrusted, token is never shared

DrawerPosition.description: Drawer position when opening a link in a drawer (optional, used when openIn === 'drawer').

position.description: Sidebar position: 'start' (default) or 'end'. End groups are rendered in the sidebar footer.

title.description: Section title shown in the admin sidebar below Dashboard.

navigation.description: Flat list of navigation items (same shape as top-level `navigation` items). Order is preserved in the admin sidebar.

AdministrationConfig.description: Custom navigation section for the staff administration panel. Admin app URL remains `backend.adminUrl` / `backend.adminPathname`. v1 is a flat list only (no nested groups).

filesUrl.description: Files explorer app URL embedded under Admin → Storage → Files (e.g. `http://localhost:5175/`).

showInSettings.description: When false, hide Settings → Storage even if `url` is set. Admin Storage is unaffected. Default: true.

StorageConfig.description: Optional storage-service wiring for the shell and admin panel. When set, admin shows the Storage sidebar (files explorer, statistics, Django admin). Settings → Storage (quota) appears when `url` is set, unless `showInSettings` is false. ShellUI will also use this for the SDK file API (`shellui.storage`).

ThemeRef.description: Built-in name, filesystem path, or inline theme object.

version.description: Theme JSON schema version. Required in theme folder JSON files (must be 1). Optional for inline config objects.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor tooling (theme JSON files).

radius.description: Shared radius applied to both modes when mode tokens omit `radius`.

colors.description: Legacy full colors object (required keys when used as a complete theme).

ThemeInput.description: Flexible theme object for config or theme JSON files. Supports compact (`light`/`dark` + `label`) and legacy (`colors` + `displayName`) shapes. Partial light/dark tokens are merged onto the default theme.

heading.description: Heading font stack (falls back to sans)

body.description: Body font stack (falls back to sans)

files.description: Font file URLs or paths (Google Fonts CSS, local `.css`, or `.woff2`). Paths in theme JSON are relative to the theme file / themesDir.

ThemeFonts.description: Optional font packaging for a theme.

chart1.description: Optional chart series colors (shadcn chart tokens).

ThemeColorsModePartial.description: Partial token overrides when extending a base theme.

recommended.description: Highlight in the selector when many themes are available.

ThemeDefinition.description: Normalized runtime theme (always complete light + dark palettes).

chart1.description: Optional chart series colors (shadcn chart tokens).

ThemeColorsMode.description: Color tokens for one mode (light or dark).

ThemesConfig.description: Array of refs, or map of id → ref (id used as name when the ref is a string/path).

dsn.description: Sentry DSN (Data Source Name). Required for Sentry to receive events.

environment.description: Environment name (e.g. 'production', 'staging'). Shown in Sentry dashboard.

release.description: Release identifier (e.g. git SHA or version). Used for release-based grouping.

SentryConfig.description: Sentry error reporting configuration. Only used in production; ignored in dev.

url.description: Base URL used to access backend APIs.

adminPathname.description: Admin route pathname (e.g. "/admin"). Used as Shell route path for embedded admin panel.

adminUrl.description: Admin content URL loaded in the admin route view (e.g. "https://example.com/admin").

loginUrl.description: Public origin (or URL) of this shell where /login and OAuth /login/callback live. Used by shellui login. Not the iframe admin app (adminUrl).

login.description: Optional login capabilities used by frontend for immediate rendering.

companyId.description: Optional tenant id used for multi-tenant shellui-auth calls.

BackendType.description: Supported backend providers for auth/API communication.

methods.description: Enabled login methods shown by the Login view.

oauthProviders.description: OAuth providers used when oauth is enabled (e.g. ["github"]).

panelUrl.description: Full-bleed iframe URL for the login left panel. When set, takes precedence over panelImage.

panelImage.description: Centered, ratio-preserving image path or URL for the login left panel (e.g. "/login-panel.jpg").

BackendLoginConfig.description: Optional login capabilities declared by app config for immediate UI rendering.

BackendLoginMethod.description: Supported auth login methods that can be declared in config.

cookies.description: List of cookies the app may use. User consent is collected per category/cookie.

CookieConsentConfig.description: Cookie consent configuration. Accepted hosts are stored in settings; store consentedCookieHosts when user submits so we can detect new cookies and re-prompt while keeping existing approvals.

name.description: Display name for the cookie (e.g. "Sentry Error Reporting").

host.description: Host or domain the cookie belongs to (e.g. "sentry.io", ".example.com"). Unique key for consent and feature gating.

category.description: Category for grouping in the consent UI.

description.description: Optional short description shown in the consent / settings UI. Can be a string or localized object with language keys.

CookieDefinition.description: Definition of a cookie that can be toggled by the user via cookie consent. Host is the unique key: use it to gate features (e.g. getCookieConsentAccepted('sentry.io')).

CookieConsentCategory.description:
Cookie consent categories for privacy-friendly grouping in the UI.
- strict_necessary: Required for the app to work; typically no consent needed.
- functional_performance: Analytics, performance, preferences.
- targeting: Advertising, personalisation.
- social_media_embedded: Social widgets, embedded content.

title: ShellUIConfig
description: Shellui application configuration (shellui.config.json). Generated from ShellUIConfig TypeScript types.
